detection_help:
A monster is tracked when it has the Lightless faction monster modifier (the Amanamu abyss monster that sits in a void cloud).

Its colour shows whether it still stands in its cloud: while inside it carries the abyss_lightless_well_immune buff.
detection_only_rare_tip:
Ignore normal and magic monsters.
Leave it on unless you see an Amanamu monster that is not marked.
detection_by_buff: Also find by Amanamu's Void buff
detection_by_buff_tip:
Also track monsters that carry the Amanamu's Void buff, even when their modifier is not readable.
Turn it off if other monsters standing in the cloud get marked too.
detection_range_tip: How far from your character (in game distance units) a monster is still picked up.
detection_keep_tip: How long a tracked monster stays marked after it moves out of the tracking range.
detection_forget_tip:
How long the marker stays at the last known spot after the game stops sending the monster
(it died or is too far away).
visibility_foreground: Only while the game window is active
visibility_foreground_tip: Hide the markers while another window is in front of the game.
visibility_hide_menu: Hide while the POEFixer menu is open
visibility_hide_menu_tip:
Hide the markers while the POEFixer menu is shown.
Leave it off to see changes live while you edit these settings.
visibility_hint: Never drawn in towns and hideouts, or while the game is paused.
marker_ring_tip: Draw a ring around the monster.
marker_label_tip: Write "{label}" and whether it is in or out of its cloud above the monster.
marker_distance_tip: Add the distance from your character to the label and to the edge arrow.
marker_ring_size_tip: Radius of the ring at Scale 100%.
marker_label_height_tip: Space between the middle of the monster and the bottom of its label, at Scale 100%.
arrow_off_screen_tip: Show an arrow at the screen edge in the direction of a tracked monster you cannot see.
arrow_on_screen: Also while the monster is on screen
arrow_on_screen_tip: Keep the edge arrow even when the monster is visible.
arrow_margin_tip:
How far inside the screen edge the arrow sits, at Scale 100%.
Raise it if the arrow hides behind the game's own UI.
look_inside_tip: Colour while the monster stands in its void cloud.
look_outside_tip: Colour once the monster has left its cloud.
look_scale_tip:
Size of rings, arrows and text.
It also follows the POEFixer font size.
look_reset_tip: Restore the default colours, scale and opacity.
diag_tip: Tracking counts, the debug window, detection logging and a reset of the markers.
diag_tracked_now: Tracked now: {tracked}. Drawn this frame: {drawn} ({ms} ms).
diag_last_pass: Last pass: {monsters} monsters, {mod_reads} mod reads, {buff_reads} buff reads, {ms} ms over {frames} frame(s).
diag_debug_window_tip:
Open a window listing every tracked monster with its modifiers and buffs.
Not saved: it is closed again next time.
diag_log: Write new finds to the POEFixer log
diag_log_tip: Add one line to the POEFixer log each time a monster starts being tracked.
diag_forget_tip:
Drop every marker now.
Monsters still around are found again within a moment.
host_too_old: This POEFixer version is too old for Amanamu Void Alert: nothing is drawn. Update POEFixer to use the plugin.
